facts.claim: The Queen’s Necklace is a chain of lights along the coast visible from Cumballa Hill.
facts.quote: the whole curve of land being jewelled with an unbroken chain of lights, which have earned the appropriate title of e The Queen’s Necklace.

facts.claim: The Lady Jamsetji Causeway opened in 1845, replacing ferry boats for communication between Bombay and Bandra.
facts.quote: The causeway was opened in 1845, up to which time communication between Bombay and Bandra, the southernmost village in Salsette, had been carried on by means of ferry-boats.
